Since this is a psychological/behavioral intervention (expectancy manipulation) and not a chemical, genetic, or physical stressor defined in the ontology, it is mapped to 'un-classified'. The study uses a paired design (Day 1 vs Day 2) and a group comparison (Placebo vs No Treatment).
